hero.title: Every tool you need to master
hero.description: Merge, split, compress, and convert PDFs with the world's most secure local processing engine. No uploads, no waiting, just precision.

tools.title: The Instrument Rack.
tools.subtitle: Professional-grade PDF tools running entirely on your local machine.
tools.mergeDesc: Combine multiple PDFs into one unified document in seconds.
tools.splitDesc: Extract specific pages or separate every page into independent files.
tools.compressDesc: Reduce file size while maintaining maximum visual quality.
tools.pdfToWordDesc: Convert PDF documents to editable Docx with high accuracy.
tools.wordToPdfDesc: Transform Word files into professional, non-editable PDFs.
tools.protectDesc: Encrypt your documents with military-grade password protection.
tools.organizeDesc: Sort, add, or delete pages from your document visually.
tools.pdfToJpgDesc: Extract every image or convert entire pages into high-res JPGs.

architecture.title: Unrivaled Privacy.
architecture.subtitle: Unlike other PDF tools, Convertofy doesn't own a server. Your data stays in the only place it should: with you.
architecture.clientSideDesc: Your documents are processed in the browser memory. They are never uploaded, stored, or seen by anyone—including us.
architecture.instantDesc: Processing at the speed of your hardware. No network bottlenecks.
architecture.secureDesc: Military-grade document handling within a sandboxed environment.
architecture.vectorDesc: Every conversion maintains 100% of the original vector data and text hierarchy. No blurry results.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, fast, and secure PDF processing right in your browser.

step1.title: Upload Your PDF
step1.desc: Drag and drop your PDF files or click to browse. No account required.

step2.title: Choose Your Tool
step2.desc: Select from Merge, Split, Compress, Convert, and more. Adjust settings as needed.

step3.title: Download Result
step3.desc: Your file is processed instantly. Download the result with one click.

privacy.title: 100% Private
privacy.desc: Files never leave your device. No uploads, no servers.

speed.title: Lightning Fast
speed.desc: Process at the speed of your hardware. No waiting in queues.

security.title: Secure
security.desc: Encrypted processing in a sandboxed environment.

compress.description: Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality. Process runs 100% in your browser.
